remaining_external_prerequisites: Calibrate the rigid link7-to-camera-optical transform and associate every captured frame with synchronized robot joint feedback.
Validate mount rigidity, cable slack, emergency-stop access, and stream continuity during supervised low-speed arm motion.
recommended_hardware_upgrade: USB 3 SuperSpeed is recommended for higher resolution, higher frame rate, or extra streams. The validated 640x400@10 Hz USB 2 profile may continue unless cable motion causes transport failures.
